services.desc: There is always more to discover! With your support, we hope to unveil these exciting, new exhibitions at The Discovery very soon! Guinness World Records Animals Live features an engaging combination of hands-on exhibits, digital interactives, and live animal displays that will immerse visitors in these animal title holders, exploring how humans and animals match up in record-setting capabilities. Every science museum needs a collection of classic experiences. Exhibits that are fun and familiar, but still give visitors that ah-ha moment each and every time.
